correctness.rationale: The exact Gamma(1)/Gamma(3) mixture yields the probability generating function and all-positive Lévy coefficients. The canonical nλ_n sequence is mapped exactly to the criterion of Steutel and van Harn (1979, Theorem 2.2, inspected in full). Its first difference has the sign of P(q), with a unique relevant root. For every n≥2 a strict uniform modulus bound applies throughout q≤q* via a positive rational certificate for 9(1−q)(1+q(1−q))³−4. Hence the iff condition has infinite-support proof. The strictly decreasing-mass counterexample at θ=2/5 is exact for all n. The packaged checker passes 501 rational assertions but is explicitly non-substitutive for the analytic quantifiers.

value.rationale: This determines a previously unclassified structural boundary for a published count law, separating universal thinning self-decomposability from ordinary compound-Poisson divisibility. It supplies exact jump rates, an exact nontrivial quartic threshold and a counterexample where strict mass decrease does not ensure thinning decomposition. Such a distinction is relevant to count-time-series marginal construction, unlike routine parameter re-expression or isolated numerical evaluations.
